ModelValidatorExternal.release_notes:
### AEMO DMAT

- **New: Model Acceptance Checks.** Quantitative checks, each threshold set in the validation configuration: no negative active power during faults, total current not reduced during faults, active current in proportion to the retained voltage, the FRT flag engaging and clearing, active power held through voltage ramps, no growing oscillation, the expected limit at SCR 1, a steady value after input steps, PSS®E initial conditions, and a flat run settled to 0.1 % by 3 s.
- **New: PSMG Final Values and Reference Steps.** Benchmarks also judge PSMG 6.2.1(d) final values and 6.3.2 reference-step agreement (rise time, overshoot and settling time within 10 %).

### AEMO GPS

- **Changed: Reactive Capability.** Judged in the direction the test dispatches (+Q supplied, -Q absorbed), and the test row's operating point reaches every check.
- **Changed: Over-Frequency Reduction.** The required reduction is kept apart from the measured one.
- **Improved: Response Checks.** Frequency response, VRT reactive response, damping (adequately damped as NER Chapter 10 defines it), FRT active power, reactive current injection and settling checks are reworked; one-sided limits are drawn and explained.
- **New: ExcludeTestSuites.** A validation can name the test suites it does not apply to.

### Channel Mapping

- **New: Current and FRT Flag Channels.** Total current, active current and FRT flag channels are mapped by name, PSS®E user channels included; missing connection-point currents are derived from P, Q and V.
- **New: Curve Names.** Each curve has a name (the Name column, filled from its type) used in the viewer, plots and report. Derived curves are not benchmarked automatically.

### Results and Reports

- **New: Validations Overview.** Covers every open test suite from the Global Reporting panel, while a suite's own overview shows only its tests. Both export to PDF with the project, the verdicts, every check that didn't pass and what each validation checks.
- **Changed: Pass Percentage.** Not evaluable results count against it.
- **Fixed: Derived Curves.** A curve derived from a channel is shown and plotted as itself.
- **Improved: Validation Report.** A per-test timeout, problems shown on the suite, one report run per results folder, and a manifest beside the report.
- **New: Plot Markers.** Every check marks what it judged on the plot.

### PSCAD

- **Fixed: Post-Fault SCR.** The grid impedance holds its pre-fault value through the fault and steps to the post-fault value when the fault clears, instead of ramping across the fault.

### App

- **Fixed: Opening Large Projects.** Opening a project with large result folders no longer freezes the app: the project history records only the project file, and its work runs in the background.
- **Fixed: Test Selection.** Ticking or unticking a test keeps the suite's Applicability column in the saved configuration.
- **Fixed: Button Icons.** The installed app shows its button icons again, along with the drop-down arrows and check marks.
- **Fixed: Update Values.** Right-click > Update values on an editable test-suite cell (such as the SCR) opens its dialog again instead of failing.
- **Changed: New Enerzinx Icon.** The app, its installer and Enerzinx App Secure carry the new Enerzinx mark.

ModelValidator.release_notes:
### Signal Plotter

- **New: Tools > Signal Plotter.** Plot channels of any test and simulator of the project, or of any result file, in one window. The results list shows one row per file (test, simulator and description); search finds channels across every file; click a plot and double-click channels to add them to it.
- **New: Add Files.** Plot result files from outside the project (PSS®E, PSCAD, TSAT, CSV or Excel); each is recognised by its extension.
- **New: Fill From Test.** Adds another test's channels of the same names beside every test curve on the page, on the same plot and axis.
- **New: Time Delay.** Shifts every curve of a file by a delay, e.g. to line PSCAD up with PSS®E.
- **New: Calculated Channels.** New channels from up to ten channels of a file and a formula (+ - * /, SQRT, SIN, COS, ATAN2, LPF, PI).
- **New: Export Page for Each Test.** The current page re-plotted for every checked test, with its metrics computed again on each test's curves: one image per test in a <project>_<date> folder, or a PDF report laid out like the validation reports: a cover, the contents, each test's plots with its metrics table on the same page, and a summary of every metric across the tests. The export runs in the background with a progress bar and can be cancelled.
- **New: Save and Restore Layout.** A layout file keeps the files, delays, calculated channels, cursors, bands and grids.

### Plots

- **New: Interval Cursors.** Two cursors, dragged or typed, with a statistics table for every curve between them: delta X, maximum, minimum, Y range, delta Y, average, RMS, slope and samples.
- **New: Label Cursor.** Reads every curve of a plot at one time.
- **New: Compute Metrics.** Any metric plugin (rise time, settling time, recovery time, commencement, instantaneous value, mean between instants, flag condition) on a curve; results in a table, markers drawn on the plot as in the reports.
- **New: Copy and Export.** Copy a chart or the whole page to the clipboard; export a chart's curves to CSV; draw a tolerance band around a curve.
- **New: Grid.** Rows and columns of a tab can be changed without losing its plots; a new tab takes the lowest free number.
- **Improved: Look.** The legend sits above the plot, the grid is lighter and y-axis labels are gone (the legend names the curves); a secondary axis leaves with its last curve.
- **Fixed: Dropping Channels.** A channel dropped near the edge of a plot lands on that plot.

These apply to the Result Viewer's free plotting too.
